field_definitions.TIMESTAMP: Invocation datetime; retrieved records explicitly carry UTC +00:00.
field_definitions.ContextTokens: Number of context tokens per request; count.
field_definitions.GeneratedTokens: Number of generated tokens per request; count.

selection: All records in the first observed calendar minute of the source file, starting at floor(first timestamp to a minute), with the right boundary confirmed by a subsequent record. At most 10,000 records are retained; at most 512 KiB of source body are read. This is a chronological, nonrandom, nonrepresentative convenience sample.
changes_from_source: Row subset only; header and selected CSV bytes are unaltered.

summary.interpretation: Chronological convenience sample describing request arrival times and token lengths only. Not a representative estimate of Azure workloads, a hardware benchmark, a scheduling experiment, or an ownership dataset.

exclusions: No prompt text or user identities are present in these fields.
No hardware service rates, memory use, power, energy, or latency are measured here.
No owner entitlements, payments, reservation values, or market behavior are observed.
The synthetic production coefficients used by the pilot are separate assumptions.
This descriptive slice is not a held-out validation of the economic model.
